newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold sees three-mine merger in July.
newsitem.headline: Randgold sees three-mine merger in July.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said on Wednesday that the merger of Durban Roodepoort Deep Ltd, Blyvooruitzicht Gold Mining Co Ltd and Buffelsfontein Gold Mines Ltd could be completed by mid-July.
The company announced earlier that Durban Deep was likely to bid for the other two gold mines on the West Rand.
"The investigation into the merger is an advanced stage and likely to be completed by June 1997," director Brian Kebble told a results presentation.
"We hope to have it (the merger) completed by mid-July 1997."
Analysts say merging the mines is in line with Randgold's philosophy of rationalising mining areas and creating economies of scale.
